description: This file defines a React functional component named Atom, which renders an SVG element with a gradient-filled circle. It uses hooks such as useState and external library hooks like useVideoConfig from remotion. The component dynamically generates a unique gradient ID to avoid conflicts and styles the SVG based on props.

methods.name: Atom
methods.description: React functional component that renders an SVG with a gradient circle, parameterized by scale and two colors.
